dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Self-limiting viral infection (viral syndrome/upper respiratory or systemic viral illness) — most likely a benign, self-resolving viral cause of the transient fever and chills, supported by complete resolution of symptoms, normal vital signs, normal inflammatory markers, and normal blood count, urine, and metabolic panels.

Alternative 1: Occult bacterial infection not yet localized (e.g., early urinary tract infection, early endocarditis, or deep-seated abscess) — would warrant re-evaluation if symptoms recur.
Alternative 2: Malaria or another imported/vector-borne infection — cannot be excluded as a peripheral blood smear was not performed.
Alternative 3: Factitious or self-induced fever — remains a possibility given the complete normalization of all objective findings, though this would require more direct evidence to confirm.
